events.title: Woodstock Festival anniversary
events.blurb: The iconic Woodstock Music & Art Fair took place in Bethel, New York, in 1969.

angles.name: Peace & Music
angles.copy: 57 years since the mud, music, and magic of Woodstock! Which legendary performance still gives you goosebumps?

events.title: Elvis Presley's passing anniversary
events.blurb: Elvis Presley, the 'King of Rock and Roll,' passed away at Graceland, Memphis, Tennessee, in 1977.

angles.name: King's Legacy
angles.copy: Remembering the King today. Elvis Presley would have been 91. His impact on music is still felt decades later. What's your favourite Elvis track?

events.title: Tupac Shakur's passing anniversary
events.blurb: Rapper Tupac Shakur was fatally shot in Las Vegas in 1996.

angles.name: Remembering Tupac
angles.copy: 30 years since we lost a hip-hop icon. Tupac Shakur would have been 55. His lyrics and legacy continue to resonate.

events.title: Jimi Hendrix's passing anniversary
events.blurb: Guitar legend Jimi Hendrix passed away in London in 1970.

angles.name: Guitar God Tribute
angles.copy: Remembering Jimi Hendrix, who would have been 84 today. His revolutionary guitar work changed music forever. What's your favourite Hendrix riff?

events.title: Abbey Road anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic eleventh studio album, 'Abbey Road', in 1969.

angles.name: Across the Abbey Road
angles.copy: 57 years since The Beatles gave us 'Abbey Road'. That iconic cover, those timeless tracks. What's your go-to song from the album?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: The Pretenders frontwoman Chrissie Hynde celebrates her 75th birthday.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Chrissie
angles.copy: Happy 75th to the incredible Chrissie Hynde! The voice of The Pretenders, still as powerful as ever. What's your favourite Pretenders hit?

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Former Oasis frontman Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday.

angles.name: Mad for it!
angles.copy: Happy 54th Birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher! The definitive voice of a generation. What's your favourite Oasis anthem?

events.title: 'Imagine' album anniversary
events.blurb: John Lennon released his iconic second studio album, 'Imagine', in 1971.

angles.name: Imagine All The People
angles.copy: 55 years since John Lennon asked us to 'Imagine'. A powerful message that still resonates today. What does this song mean to you?

events.title: iPod launch anniversary
events.blurb: Apple introduced the first generation of its groundbreaking iPod portable music player in 2001.

angles.name: Pocket Full of Tunes
angles.copy: Remember when you could fit 1,000 songs in your pocket? 25 years since Apple launched the original iPod and changed how we listen to music forever.

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: James Bond Day marks the anniversary of the world premiere of the first 007 film, 'Dr. No', in 1962.

angles.name: Shaken, Not Stirred
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! From iconic gadgets to unforgettable theme songs, who is your favourite 007 and what's the best Bond movie moment?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: The legendary Beatles co-founder John Lennon would have celebrated his 86th birthday.

angles.name: Lennon's Legacy
angles.copy: Remembering John Lennon on what would have been his 86th birthday. His music and message of peace continue to inspire. Which Lennon song means the most to you?

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Comedic icon and Monty Python star John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday.

angles.name: Silly Walks & More
angles.copy: Happy 87th Birthday to the brilliant John Cleese! From Monty Python to Fawlty Towers, he's given us endless laughs. What's your favourite Cleese moment?

events.title: 'White Album' anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their self-titled double album, commonly known as the 'White Album', in 1968.

angles.name: A Blank Canvas
angles.copy: 58 years since The Beatles unleashed the 'White Album'. Its eclectic mix and stark cover made it a masterpiece. What's your stand-out track?

events.title: Freddie Mercury's passing anniversary
events.blurb: Queen's iconic frontman Freddie Mercury passed away in 1991.

angles.name: The Show Must Go On
angles.copy: Remembering the one and only Freddie Mercury, who would have been 80. His incredible voice and stage presence remain unmatched. What's your favourite Queen song?
